description: This file defines Pydantic models used for data validation and API responses in the VoltSurge application. The models include session tracking, health check responses, dataset status, CSV preview data, and dataset normalization/processing responses.

classes.name: SessionInfo
classes.description: Holds session identifiers and timestamps for tracking user sessions.

classes.name: HealthResponse
classes.description: Represents the health check response with status, app name, and version.

classes.name: DatasetStatusResponse
classes.description: Provides high-level status about the current in-memory dataset for a session.

classes.name: ColumnSchema
classes.description: Profiles each data column with counts and example values derived from a preview.

classes.name: CsvUploadPreviewResponse
classes.description: Contains details of the CSV upload process including schema and preview data.

classes.name: DatasetSelectColumnsRequest
classes.description: Request model for selecting columns for data normalization, including region and usage unit.

classes.name: ProcessedDatasetSummary
classes.description: Summarizes metadata about the processed dataset, including row counts and units.

classes.name: DatasetSelectColumnsResponse
classes.description: Response model containing processed dataset preview and summary information.
